description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans membership table implementation using Consul as the backend. It verifies core functionalities such as reading, writing, updating membership entries, gateway discovery, and cleanup of defunct silos, ensuring that the Consul-based membership provider operates correctly. The tests are designed to interact with an external Consul cluster and include setup for logging and connection configuration.

classes.name: ConsulMembershipTableTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the functionality of the Orleans membership table with a Consul backend. It includes setup for creating the membership table and gateway list provider, as well as multiple test cases for core membership operations.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Configures logging filters for Consul and storage logs to trace level during tests.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of Consul-based membership table configured with the test server address.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates an instance of Consul-based gateway list provider for client gateway discovery.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Retrieves the connection string to the Consul cluster asynchronously.
